Q: Docker command/option to display or list the build context A:

Output to terminal - without modifying a Dockerfile and without creating files outside the Docker image

printf 'FROM scratch\nCOPY . /' | DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build -q -f- -o- . | tar t

Source: https://github.com/moby/buildkit/issues/1181#issuecomment-1633355732, which is based on https://stackoverflow.com/a/61821807/873282.

Q: Google sheets errors while trying to create dynamic search A:

An { array expression } collects ranges into a virtual array, which means that you cannot refer to its columns with column labels like A. To make it work, replace A with Col1.

Array expressions can be tricky to debug, so it's usually easier to use the the vstack() function. It gets a similar virtual array without requiring carefully placed ;,\ delimiters.

To avoid issues with query column type, get the header row 'Bin 1'!A1:C1 just once, and in subsequent references use 'Bin 2'!A2:C and so on.

The expression select \* is using an incorrect syntax. Use select * or leave out the whole select clause. In a query statement, all clauses are optional, including select.

Putting that together:

=query(
  vstack('Bin 1'!A1:C, 'Bin 2'!A2:C, 'Bin 3'!A2:C, 'Bin 4'!A2:C, 'Bin 5'!A2:C, 'Bin 6'!A2:C, 'Bin 7'!A2:C, 'Bin 8'!A2:C, 'Bin 9'!A2:C, 'Bin 10'!A2:C, 'Bin 11'!A2:C, 'Bin 12'!A2:C, 'Bin 13'!A2:C, 'Bin 14'!A2:C, 'Bin 15'!A2:C, 'Bin 16'!A2:C, 'Bin 17'!A2:C, 'Bin 18'!A2:C, 'Bin 19'!A2:C, 'Bin 20'!A2:C, 'Bin 21'!A2:C, 'Bin 22'!A2:C, 'Bin 23'!A2:C, 'Bin 24'!A2:C, 'Bin 25'!A2:C, 'Bin 26'!A2:C, 'Bin 27'!A2:C, 'Bin 28'!A2:C, 'Bin 29'!A2:C, 'Bin 30'!A2:C, 'Bin 31'!A2:C, 'Bin 32'!A2:C), 
  "where lower(Col1) contains '" & lower(A2) & "' ", 
  1
)

See Query Language Reference and vstack().

Q: Get first and last day of any year A:

For getting first day and last day of the year, and the first of the next year.

SELECT
   DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy,0,getdate()), 0) AS Start_Of_Year,
 dateadd(yy, datediff(yy,-1, getdate()), -1) AS Last_Day_Of_Year,
   DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy,0,getdate()) + 1, 0) AS FirstOf_the_NextYear

So putting this in your query

;WITH CT AS(
    SELECT Points
        , Date
        , DATEPART(DY,Date) DA
    FROM Table

WHERE DATEPART(DY,Date) BETWEEN 
DATEPART(day,DATEADD(yy, DATEDIFF(yy,0,getdate()), 0)) AND  
DATEPART(day,dateadd(yy, datediff(yy,-1, getdate()), -1))
)

SELECT MIN(c.Date) MinYear
    , MAX(c.Date) MaxYear
FROM CT c
GROUP BY YEAR(c.Date)
